title: dodecatheon jeffreyi var. vivaparum
intro: Dodecatheon jeffreyi var. vivaparum, commonly known as the Western Pasque Flower, is a perennial plant species within the Primulaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional herbal medicine. The health benefits of Dodecatheon jeffreyi var. vivaparum include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help in the treatment of various health issues such as wounds and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit sedative, anti-tumor, and anti-oxidant effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids.
